sources.title: YuE2: Frontier AI Music Generation With Editable Scores
sources.snippet: Explore YuE2, the open music model with editable scores. Hear official demos and create songs online from lyrics, style prompts or reference audio. Try it free.

sources.title: YuE2 · Frontier Music with Symbolic Planning
sources.snippet: YuE2 unifies symbolic and audio music generation in one model, with frontier song quality competitive with Suno v5/v6. Through symbolic planning, it writes an editable score, then brings the composition to life with vocals and accompaniment.
